title: Joomla Extension - onlinecommunityhub.nl - Unrestricted write of downloaded remote files into a public folder in…
description: A vulnerability in the Joomla ochResponsiveImages extension versions 1.0.0 through 4.2.0 allowed unrestricted writing of downloaded remote files into a public image cache folder when the 'Include Remote Images' feature was enabled. The plugin did not verify that the downloaded content was a valid image, potentially allowing arbitrary file writes. This issue was fixed in version 4.2.1 by restricting stored files to JPEG, PNG, WebP, and AVIF image formats.
